testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The HCP has authenticated in the system (UC2). An Emergency Responder is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The Emergency Responder has authenticated in the system (UC2).

step.actions: user: The approved user enters the desired patients First and/or Last Name (or a correct substring of either/both) into the search box. The patients with first/last names containing the substring(s) provided are shown.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: Record for
testcase.preconditions: An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The HCP has authenticated in the system (UC2). An Emergency Responder is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The Emergency Responder has authenticated in the system (UC2).

step.actions: patient: The approved user selects the patient they wish to see the Emergency Health Records for. The patients Emergency Health Records page is pulled up. The patients name, age, date of birth, gender, and blood type are neatly displayed, followed by a list of all diagnosis codes for short-term diagnoses within the last 60 days (sorted by most recent first). Lastly, a list of all prescriptions the patient has received in the last 90 days is shown (sorted by most recent first).
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
